input.description: A small fox folds a paper boat and follows it down the river to find out where the water goes.
input.cover_ideas: Watercolor style, a small orange fox on a riverbank watching a paper boat, soft spring colors

prompt: Watercolor children's cover, one soft spring scene of pale greens, sky blue, and warm gold light. A small orange fox on a grassy riverbank watches a white paper boat drift on a gentle stream among reeds and blossoms. Playful rounded lettering spells "Pip and the Paper Boat" across the sky; smaller elegant script reads "Eszter Kovacs" near the fox. No other text.
